levelDescriptions.full: Adjust skills, knowledge and instructions, invite people and set rights.
levelDescriptions.use: Chat in the workspace and create content.

dialog.title: Members of “{{workspace}}”

dialog.noFullAccess: People with full access here can invite people and change rights.
dialog.noRight: In your organisation, only {{list}} may invite.
dialog.noRightPeople: In your organisation, only {{list}} may invite individual people and teams.

dialog.loadError: The members could not be loaded.

picker.placeholder: Search for a person or team

picker.loadError: The people and teams to invite could not be loaded.

list.teamFootnote: People who join the team later get “{{level}}”.
list.organizationFootnote: People who join the organisation later get “Can use”.

toasts.invitedMany: {{count}} people and teams now have access to “{{workspace}}”.
toasts.organizationShared: “{{workspace}}” is now shared with the entire organisation.
toasts.unlinkedPerson: The own skills and knowledge collections of {{name}} are no longer linked here.
toasts.unlinkedOrganization: Own skills and knowledge collections of people without access are no longer linked here.

confirmOrganization.title: Share with the entire organisation?
confirmOrganization.description: Everyone in your organisation can then use “{{workspace}}” and everything linked there. This also applies to everyone who joins later. You can then give individual people more rights or take access away again.

confirmEnd.title: End sharing with the organisation?
confirmEnd.description: Only invited people and teams will then have access to “{{workspace}}”.

confirmEndTeam.title: End the share with team {{team}}?
confirmEndTeam.description: Everyone who only has access to “{{workspace}}” through this team loses it. People who join the team later get no access.

noAccess.title: No access to this workspace
noAccess.description: Ask the person who manages it for an invitation.
